scope: Local mock UI replay and native Pixi/Spine contact sheets; no live RGS and no video capture.

visualReview.lowSymbols: S,L1-L4 reviewed at the same six frames: inner portrait depth on S and restrained root beats for low symbols.
visualReview.character: Native react_small at 0,.12,.32,.52,.65,.8s: downward anticipation, board glance, raised-hand hold and recovery. Full-body silhouette and snake artwork retained.
visualReview.drop: 0,126,216,261,306,333,360ms: first contact followed by two decreasing rebounds, without a second landing animation.
visualReview.feature: Free-game three-orb shared renderer with sound enabled reached x178 / $178.00 and resting body pose; glasses remained on forehead.

turbo: Native timing check passed all 16 comparisons; character, charge, orb flight, sound, collision and readout clocks remain identical at OFF/T1/T2. Only board timings scale. UI restored to OFF.

console.notes: One existing Pixi TextStyle warning was observed in dev; the game completed both rounds. No errors were reported in the FG preview.

limits: Mock/headless replay checks lifecycle, not production frame pacing or wallet accounting. Earlier portrait and 15-spin feature checks are historical, not rerun for this revision. Original synthetic casting voice retained.
